items.title: Coherent Soars 18%, Lumentum Up 12% as AI Optics Rebound Extends Despite Nvidia Turmoil
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares jumped 18% today with no company news, as AI hardware stocks rebounded. Lumentum, Astera Labs and Nebius rose too, even as Nvidia fell on its board’s probe of CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD, CoreWeave,  Coherent, First Solar, Trade Desk, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nvidia falls after the chip maker’s board launches an investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a suspected Chinese spy.

items.title: Coherent Jumps 13% as Optical Stocks Extend AI Rebound; Lumentum Surges 11%, Applied Optoelectronics Rises 4%
items.summary: Optical stocks are bouncing back from last week's AI selloff, but the gains are far from equal. Cash burn, a pending Marvell deal, and a stark analyst split explain why one name pulls ahead while another lags.

items.title: AAOI Stock Rises 7% Post Q3 Earnings: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics shares jump 6.9% after Q3 earnings as AI-driven demand fuels growth, but margin pressure, stiff competition and premium valuation raise concerns.

items.title: Coherent Is Up 21% in a Year as AI Goes “From Copper to Optical.” Is It a Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent stock is up 21% in the past year, but it’s about 56% below the peak it set in June, a run helped by Nvidia’s $2 billion investment. Revenue rose 50% in the September quarter, management now expects fiscal 2027 pro forma revenue growth above 60%, and it signed a PhotonLink deal valued at about $20 billion.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Says AI Demand Will Outrun Its Capacity Through 2027
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics is sold out of 1.6T transceivers, signed a hyperscaler deal worth up to $1.5 billion, and still guided below Wall Street. Is the capacity crunch a growth engine or the excuse behind another letdown?

items.title: Coherent Stock Fell 8% in a Week. J.P. Morgan Sees 100% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent (COHR) stock fell 8% during the week ended November 6, closing at $193 despite a sharp Friday rebound. Marvell Technology (MRVL) agreed to acquire Lumentum (LITE) in a $115 billion all-stock deal, potentially strengthening competition in AI optical connectivity.

items.title: Nvidia, Intel, Tesla, AMD, Coherent, Lam Research, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nvidia trades higher Friday after recording its second-largest one-day market cap decline on record on Thursday.
